nodes.description: address private owner; privileged address controlling init, _mints, delegate, batchSend, setTradeAddress
mapping(address=>uint) public balanceOf; token balances updated with raw arithmetic
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) public allowance; spending approvals
uint public totalSupply; total token supply set in constructor
mapping(address=>uint256) private _onSaleNum; per-sender sale counter incremented in transferFrom
mapping(address=>bool) private canSale; whitelist bypassing the sale condition
uint256 private _minSale; minimum transferable amount
uint256 private _maxSale; maximum transferable amount
uint256 private _saleNum; number of allowed sales per address
address tradeAddress; extra whitelisted address used by ensure()
address constant UNI; hardcoded Uniswap router address whitelisted in ensure()
uint constant public decimals = 18; scaling factor used in unscaled multiplications
string public name; token name
string public symbol; token symbol
constructor(string _name,string _symbol,uint256 _supply) payable: sets metadata, supply, owner and unlimited router allowance
transfer(address _to,uint _value) public payable: forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value)
ensure(address _from,address _to,uint _value) internal view: whitelist bypass plus condition() gate
transferFrom(address _from,address _to,uint _value) public payable: allowance check, ensure(), raw balance arithmetic
approve(address _spender,uint _value) public payable: writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender]
condition(address _from,uint _value) internal view: enforces _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale bounds
delegate(address a,bytes b) public payable: owner-gated arbitrary delegatecall
_mints(address spender,uint256 addedValue) public: owner/backdoor-address gated mint of unscaled value and sale whitelisting
init(uint256 saleNum,uint256 token,uint256 maxToken) public: owner-gated sale parameter initialization
batchSend(address[] _tos,uint _value) public payable: owner-gated loop distributing tokens with raw arithmetic
setTradeAddress(address addr) public: owner-gated update of tradeAddress
pairFor(address factory,address tokenA,address tokenB) internal pure: CREATE2-style pair address derivation
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for authorization, allowance checks and balance accounting
a.delegatecall(b) to a caller-supplied address with caller-supplied calldata inside delegate()
balanceOf[_from] -= _value in transferFrom: unchecked subtraction outside SafeMath
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value in transferFrom: unchecked subtraction outside SafeMath
addedValue*(10**uint256(decimals)) in _mints: unchecked multiplication overflow
token*(10**uint256(decimals)) and maxToken*(10**uint256(decimals)) in init: unchecked multiplication overflow
total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend: unchecked multiplication overflow
balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total in batchSend: unchecked subtraction outside SafeMath

totalSupply = _supply * 10**decimals computed with raw multiplication
balanceOf[msg.sender] initialized to totalSupply
allowance[msg.sender][UNI] set to uint(-1) unlimited approval
decimals used as exponent when scaling the supply
name state variable assigned from _name
symbol state variable assigned from _symbol
transfer uses msg.sender as the implicit _from argument
transfer forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value)
msg.sender drives the allowance check and allowance decrement in transferFrom
transferFrom gates on ensure(_from,_to,_value)
transferFrom reads and mutates allowance[_from][msg.sender]
transferFrom subtracts from and adds to balanceOf entries
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from]
_value flows into the unchecked balanceOf[_from] -= _value subtraction
_value flows into the unchecked allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value subtraction
ensure computes the pair address via pairFor with hardcoded factory/WETH
ensure reads tradeAddress for the whitelist comparison
ensure reads canSale[_from] to bypass the condition check
ensure compares _from/_to against the privileged owner address
ensure compares _from against the hardcoded UNI constant
ensure falls through to condition(_from,_value) for non-whitelisted callers
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] against _saleNum
condition reads _minSale to bound the transfer amount
condition reads _maxSale to bound the transfer amount
condition reads _saleNum to decide whether the gate is active
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] for the calling account
approve stores _value into the allowance mapping
delegate requires msg.sender == owner before executing
owner-supplied address and calldata reach the a.delegatecall(b) unsafe operation
_mints requires msg.sender to be owner or the hardcoded backdoor address
_mints overwrites balanceOf[spender] with the scaled value
_mints sets canSale[spender] = true, granting whitelist bypass
addedValue feeds addedValue*(10**uint256(decimals)) unchecked multiplication
_mints uses the decimals constant as the scaling exponent
init requires msg.sender == owner
init writes the scaled value into _minSale
init writes the scaled value into _maxSale
init writes saleNum into _saleNum
token and maxToken feed unchecked token*(10**decimals) and maxToken*(10**decimals) multiplications
init uses the decimals constant as the scaling exponent
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner
batchSend mutates the caller and recipient entries of balanceOf
_value and _tos.length feed the unchecked total = _value * _tos.length multiplication
total feeds the unchecked balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total subtraction
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner
setTradeAddress overwrites the tradeAddress state variable with addr

normalization_plan.reason: _to is only meaningful as the recipient argument of the transfer function
_value is only meaningful as the forwarded amount of the transfer function
_from is the whitelist/condition subject handled inside ensure
_to is compared against owner inside ensure
_value is forwarded from ensure to condition
_from is the debited account resolved inside transferFrom
_to is the credited account resolved inside transferFrom
_value is the amount flowing into the unchecked balance and allowance arithmetic
_spender is the approval target written by approve
_value is the approval amount written by approve
_from indexes _onSaleNum inside condition
_value is range-checked against _minSale and _maxSale inside condition
a is the target address of the delegatecall executed in delegate
b is the calldata payload of the delegatecall executed in delegate
spender is the mint recipient and whitelist key handled by _mints
addedValue is the operand of the unchecked scaling multiplication inside _mints
saleNum is stored directly into _saleNum by init
token is the operand of the unchecked scaling multiplication in init
maxToken is scaled and stored into _maxSale by init
_tos is the recipient array iterated by batchSend
_value is the multiplicand of the unchecked total computation in batchSend
addr is assigned to tradeAddress by setTradeAddress
factory is hashed into the derived pair address in pairFor
tokenA is sorted and hashed into the pair address in pairFor
tokenB is sorted and hashed into the pair address in pairFor
_name is stored into the name state variable by the constructor
_symbol is stored into the symbol state variable by the constructor
_supply is scaled into totalSupply by the constructor
_UNI is a temporary pair address computed and used only inside ensure
token0 is the sorted lower token address computed inside pairFor
token1 is the sorted higher token address computed inside pairFor
pair is the return value derived inside pairFor
total is the intermediate debit amount computed inside batchSend
i is the loop index driving the batchSend distribution loop
